summary: The page is a careful development of LTL: syntax, semantics, soundness, Hintikka sequences, completeness via maximal sets, and a small-model/decidability argument. I checked the cited results against their uses (ltl-valid items 2–4, ltl-normality, ltl-successor, pdl-atom-properties, pdl-normality, pdl-kozen-parikh) and the proofs of the successor lemma, the fulfilment lemma, completeness Step 1 (the round-robin scheduling argument), and the periodic-model theorem (cutting argument, bounds $q\le2^{m}$, $\ell\le(m+1)2^{m}$). All appear correct. The only candidate issue I found (the enumeration of $\mathrm{CL}(\mathbf{G}\mathbf{F}p)$ in the last problem's solution) dissolves under the abbreviation convention, so I report no issues.
